schema.sql: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX ix_roles_name ON roles (name)

schema.sql: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX ix_users_username ON users (username)

schema.name: uq_cloud_auth_connections_owner_provider_mode_client
schema.sql: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX uq_cloud_auth_connections_owner_provider_mode_client ON cloud_auth_connections (owner_user_id, provider, auth_mode, client_id) WHERE client_id IS NOT NULL AND auth_mode IN ('tenant', 'service_account')

schema.name: alembic_version
schema.sql:
CREATE TABLE alembic_version (
	version_num VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	CONSTRAINT alembic_version_pkc PRIMARY KEY (version_num)
)

schema.name: cloud_auth_connections
schema.sql:
CREATE TABLE cloud_auth_connections (
	connection_id VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	tenant_id VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	provider VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	auth_mode VARCHAR(32) DEFAULT 'oauth_user' NOT NULL, 
	credential_ciphertext TEXT NOT NULL, 
	auth_state_ciphertext TEXT DEFAULT '' NOT NULL, 
	status VARCHAR(32) DEFAULT 'ACTIVE' NOT NULL, 
	last_error TEXT DEFAULT '' NOT NULL, 
	created_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP NOT NULL, 
	updated_at DATETIME, owner_user_id VARCHAR(64) DEFAULT '' NOT NULL, provider_account_id VARCHAR(255) DEFAULT '' NOT NULL, display_name VARCHAR(255) DEFAULT '' NOT NULL, provider_tenant_key VARCHAR(255) DEFAULT '' NOT NULL, provider_account_meta TEXT DEFAULT '' NOT NULL, scope TEXT DEFAULT '' NOT NULL, last_used_at DATETIME, client_id VARCHAR(255), connection_method VARCHAR(32) DEFAULT 'legacy_byo' NOT NULL, credential_location VARCHAR(16) DEFAULT 'local' NOT NULL, cloud_connection_id VARCHAR(64), cloud_owner_user_id VARCHAR(64) DEFAULT '' NOT NULL, provider_workspace_id VARCHAR(255) DEFAULT '' NOT NULL, capability_contract_version VARCHAR(64) DEFAULT '' NOT NULL, profile_ref VARCHAR(255) DEFAULT '' NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (connection_id)
)

schema.name: group_permissions
schema.sql:
CREATE TABLE group_permissions (
	id CHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	group_id CHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	permission_group_id CHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	created_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP NOT NULL, 
	updated_at DATETIME, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(group_id) REFERENCES groups (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, 
	FOREIGN KEY(permission_group_id) REFERENCES permission_groups (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, 
	CONSTRAINT uq_group_permission UNIQUE (group_id, permission_group_id)
)

schema.name: groups
schema.sql:
CREATE TABLE groups (
	id CHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	tenant_id VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	group_name VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL, 
	remark VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL, 
	creator_user_id CHAR(32), 
	created_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP NOT NULL, 
	updated_at DATETIME, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(creator_user_id) REFERENCES users (id) ON DELETE SET NULL, 
	CONSTRAINT uq_tenant_group_name UNIQUE (tenant_id, group_name)
)

schema.name: mcp_oauth_grants
schema.sql:
CREATE TABLE mcp_oauth_grants (
	grant_id VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	user_id VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	server_id VARCHAR(128) NOT NULL, 
	server_url TEXT NOT NULL, 
	grant_version INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	token_version INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	status VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	ciphertext TEXT NOT NULL, 
	expires_at FLOAT NOT NULL, 
	lease_id VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	lease_until FLOAT NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (grant_id), 
	CONSTRAINT uq_mcp_oauth_owner_server UNIQUE (user_id, server_id)
)

schema.name: mcp_oauth_states
schema.sql:
CREATE TABLE mcp_oauth_states (
	state_hash VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	grant_id VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	grant_version INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	expires_at FLOAT NOT NULL, 
	ciphertext TEXT NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (state_hash)
)

schema.name: permission_groups
schema.sql:
CREATE TABLE permission_groups (
	id CHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	code VARCHAR(128) NOT NULL, 
	description VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL, 
	module VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	action VARCHAR(16) NOT NULL, 
	created_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP NOT NULL, 
	updated_at DATETIME, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id)
)

schema.name: role_permissions
schema.sql:
CREATE TABLE role_permissions (
	id CHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	role_id CHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	permission_group_id CHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	created_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP NOT NULL, 
	updated_at DATETIME, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(permission_group_id) REFERENCES permission_groups (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, 
	FOREIGN KEY(role_id) REFERENCES roles (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, 
	CONSTRAINT uq_role_permission UNIQUE (role_id, permission_group_id)
)

schema.name: roles
schema.sql:
CREATE TABLE roles (
	id CHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	name VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	built_in BOOLEAN NOT NULL, 
	created_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP NOT NULL, 
	updated_at DATETIME, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id)
)

schema.name: user_groups
schema.sql:
CREATE TABLE user_groups (
	id CHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	tenant_id VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	user_id CHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	group_id CHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	role VARCHAR(16) NOT NULL, 
	creator_user_id CHAR(32), 
	created_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP NOT NULL, 
	updated_at DATETIME, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(creator_user_id) REFERENCES users (id) ON DELETE SET NULL, 
	FOREIGN KEY(group_id) REFERENCES groups (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, 
	FOREIGN KEY(user_id) REFERENCES users (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, 
	CONSTRAINT uq_tenant_user_group UNIQUE (tenant_id, user_id, group_id)
)

schema.name: users
schema.sql:
CREATE TABLE users (
	id CHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	username VARCHAR(128) NOT NULL, 
	display_name VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL, 
	password_hash VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL, 
	role_id CHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	tenant_id VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	email VARCHAR(255), 
	phone VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	remark VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL, 
	creator VARCHAR(128) NOT NULL, 
	created_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP NOT NULL, 
	updated_at DATETIME, 
	last_login_time DATETIME, 
	updated_pwd_time DATETIME, 
	disabled BOOLEAN NOT NULL, 
	source VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(role_id) REFERENCES roles (id) ON DELETE RESTRICT
)
